facts.value: Study and research in the heart of Europe! As an international university with an excellent reputation, Goethe University offers a wide range of programs.
All important information regarding your path to us is summarized: from admission requirements and application to language skills.
The Global Office supports international exchange students and scholarship holders during their stay at Goethe University - from preparation to personal support on-site in Frankfurt.
The Goethe Welcome Centre has compiled important information and offers for international postdocs, doctoral candidates, and professors at Goethe University.
From initial advice to a buddy program: Goethe University offers services for application, scholarships, residency rights, and much more - for a successful start in Frankfurt.
Discover our diverse study offerings for international students in Frankfurt - first-class teaching, exciting research, and a vibrant campus await you.
Need support for your career start? The International Career Service Rhein-Main helps you successfully transition from study to profession in the German job market.

Goethe University supports refugees before, during, and after their studies. The offer includes preparatory and language courses, scholarships, support with finding housing, administrative procedures, financing, and integration.
Explore language offerings and opportunities for preparatory studies for foreign applicants at Goethe University.
